subcategory_text: Data corrections or deletions can be communicated to individuals or organizations (e.g., data sources) in the data processing ecosystem.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SI-18 (Information Quality), PM-22
GDPR Art. 16 (Right to rectification), Art. 19 (Notification of rectification/erasure)
implementation_examples: When data is corrected or deleted, notify the individuals and the organisations (data sources, joint controllers, processors) that received it, where notification is required or useful
Track notifications to closure and capture evidence
Provide a clear, single point for downstream recipients to action the correction
assessment_objectives: Determine whether data corrections or deletions are notified to individuals and source organisations
Determine whether notifications are tracked to closure
Determine whether evidence of notifications is captured
Determine whether downstream recipients can action the correction consistently
